# Muse English

> Free daily English lessons (A1-C2) with vocabulary, podcast, shadowing, grammar and quizzes.

## Blog

- [Daily English Lessons](https://museenglishapp.com/blog/): pick your level, new lessons every day.
- [A1 Beginner lessons](https://museenglishapp.com/blog/a1/)
- [A2 Elementary lessons](https://museenglishapp.com/blog/a2/)
- [B1 Intermediate lessons](https://museenglishapp.com/blog/b1/)
- [B2 Upper-Intermediate lessons](https://museenglishapp.com/blog/b2/)
- [C1 Advanced lessons](https://museenglishapp.com/blog/c1/)
- [C2 Proficient lessons](https://museenglishapp.com/blog/c2/)

## App

- [Muse English app](https://museenglishapp.com): daily lessons, podcast, shadowing with pronunciation scoring.
